item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Oregon fire looms near town as 4th firefighter dies weeks after Colorado blaze
item.description: As dry, windy weather fueled a big wildfire near a city in central Oregon, a fourth firefighter died after he and several colleagues last month were overcome by a fast-moving wildfire near the Colorado-Utah border.

[WFLA News Channel 8] Several people are injured at Berlin's LGBTQ+ march after a car drives into the crowd
item.description: A car drove into a crowd during Berlin's famed LGBTQ+ parade on Saturday and injured several people, prompting police to call off the event in the German capital hours after it had begun. Police said some of the victims had life-threatening injuries.
